Operates as a single segment engaged in wholesaling and manufacturing of gold ornaments.
Filed restated financial results for Q1, Q2 and Q3 FY26 applying Weighted Average Cost method for inventory valuation retrospectively from April 01, 2024.

timeline.summary: Shanti Gold International reported postal ballot voting results approving the re-appointment and remuneration increase for its MD and WTD on April 25, 2026.
Shanti Gold International approved a voluntary accounting policy change for inventory valuation from FIFO to Weighted Average Cost method retrospectively from April 1, 2024.
Acuité Ratings submitted Monitoring Agency Report for Shanti Gold International showing ₹45.25 Cr unutilised IPO proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹658.93 Cr, net profit ₹51.93 Cr.
Shanti Gold International submitted restated unaudited financial results for Q1, Q2, and Q2FY26 pursuant to inventory valuation policy change.
Shanti Gold presented Q4 & FY26 investor presentation detailing plans to scale manufacturing capacity from 2,700 kg pa to 7,900 kg pa.
Shanti Gold International reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹658.93 Cr (+121.65% YoY) and PAT of ₹51.93 Cr (+465.30% YoY).
Shanti Gold International Limited shared the Q4FY26 earnings call audio link on May 22, 2026, via its website.
Shanti Gold hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call detailing capacity expansion plans and FY27 guidance.
Shanti Gold International promoters declared zero share encumbrance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
Manojkumar Jain, Promoter, declared no encumbrance on Shanti Gold International’s shares held by Promoters/PAC during FY2026 ending March 31, 2026.
Shanti Gold commenced commercial production at its new Marol manufacturing facility, adding 4,000 kg/pa capacity on June 8, 2026.
Shanti Gold International Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings call on August 20, 2026, reporting a 144.69% YoY revenue growth to ₹716.38 Cr and maintaining FY27 guidance at ₹3,500 Cr.
